// diagnostic

E0167

State `{state}` collides with a member of `{type}`

What

State `{state}` collides with a member of `{type}`

Why

State facts and ordinary members share the owning type's namespace

Fix

Rename the state or the member so `Type.State.{state}` is unique

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0167: tests/ui/typestate/member_collision_in_separate_impl_is_e0167.stderr.

Error [jet.CasingMismatch]: State `open` must be PascalCase
  --> tests/ui/typestate/member_collision_in_separate_impl_is_e0167.jet:1:23
    |
  1 | struct Door { state { open } }
    |                       ^^^^
 Why: Jet enforces PascalCase for type-like names, snake_case for value-like names, and ALL_CAPS (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE) for module-global constants
 Fix: Rename it to `Open`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0357

Error [jet.TypestateMemberConflict]: State `open` collides with a member of `Door`
  --> tests/ui/typestate/member_collision_in_separate_impl_is_e0167.jet:1:23
    |
  1 | struct Door { state { open } }
    |                       ^^^^
 Why: State facts and ordinary members share the owning type's namespace
 Fix: Rename the state or the member so `Type.State.open` is unique
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0167
